title: La Aparente Inutilidad de la IA Cuántica

facts.fact: The video's verdict is that quantum AI is at an intermediate point: not pure hype, but not the next revolution replacing classical AI, at least in the medium term; promising theoretical results have yet to become practical advantages.
facts.trap: Quantum AI will replace classical AI / is the next AI revolution.

evidence.quote: ¿Es la siguiente revolución, la que sucederá a la IA clásica? Ya lo digo, desde luego no.

facts.fact: Quantum AI is typically hybrid: a quantum computer operates on qubits while a classical computer tunes the parameters (variational quantum circuits) or, in the kernel example, a classical support vector machine finds the boundary.

evidence.quote: tenemos un ordenador cuántico para hacer las operaciones con los qubits y uno clásico para afinar sus parámetros. Un enfoque híbrido que es bastante habitual en la IA cuántica.

facts.fact: The worked example of a proven quantum advantage (classifying roulette squares, based on the discrete logarithm problem) is an artificially constructed problem with no practical application; it would not work on general data such as diagnosing patients.
facts.trap: The quantum classifier is useful for real tasks such as medical diagnosis.

evidence.quote: es un problema que hemos construido artificialmente para demostrar una ventaja cuántica

facts.fact: The advantage cannot yet be tested in practice because it needs quantum computers with many well error-controlled qubits; repeated measurements and loading classical data into quantum states can also eat up the advantage, and some quantum algorithms have later been 'dequantized'.

evidence.quote: Por el momento, ni siquiera podemos comprobar esa ventaja en la práctica.

facts.fact: The most promising use is processing data that is already quantum (molecules, materials); its real potential is complementing classical AI in specific tasks, e.g. advanced science, not replacing it.

evidence.quote: No de sustituir a la IA clásica, sino complementarla en ciertas tareas específicas, tal vez de ciencia avanzada.
